title: Sellner Explorer
body:
All you could ever need for spacious storage! Beautiful oak planks for holding up all your resources.

The Sellner Explorer is a vehicle that can be purchased from The Oak Depot for $27,000. It is a large heavy-duty pickup truck.

Details

The Sellner Explorer is a vehicle well suited for hauling cargo. Its bed measures 7 by 14 studs, with the guards on the side having a depth of 5 studs. However, the tailgate is only 2 studs tall. Unlike other vehicles, the Explorer is virtually unaffected by going off-road, while still maintaining a relatively high speed at all times. Only the Oakmobile consistently outspeeds the Explorer.

The Explorer comes in a total of 24 colors; 12 common and 12 rare. The common colors include pink, black, gray, purple, bronze, teal, turquoise, sand yellow, olive green, sage green, dark gray, light gray. The rare colors include white, vibrant red, gold/orange, Pyrite yellow, lime green, vibrant green, cyan, vibrant light blue, vibrant blue, vibrant purple, Magnetite purple, and cherry red/pink. All the common colors possess equal rarity, as do the rare colors; however, unboxing a rare color possesses a 1 in 100 chance. Additionally, there are neon variants of both the common and rare colors. Unboxing a neon common color possesses a 1 in 10,000 chance, and unboxing a neon rare color a 1 in 1,000,000 chance.

The Explorer's spawn pad measures 31 by 0.65 by 15 studs.

Trivia

  • Prior to v1.52.0, the Explorer was $18,025
  • In v1.52.0, the Explorer was $36,050
  • In v1.54.3, the Explorer's model changed.
  • An Explorer can be found sunken in a lake in Ferwater near where the Pirate Boat spawns.
